newsitem.title: UK: Asian jet fuel demand stirs Med interest.
newsitem.headline: Asian jet fuel demand stirs Med interest.

text.p: Asian jet fuel demand shifted the focus of European trade to the Med on Thursday, with buyers around fob Med high +$6/8 and sellers at +$7/8 basis Italy, traders said.

Much of the demand from India and Far Eastern destinations was for dual purpose kerosene, while available material was mainly aviation specification and shipping availabilities were reported difficult.

Med demand from west of Suez was minimal. EU origin material was seen around fob Med high +$6/9. Benchmark Jan IPE futures rose 50 cents to $205.50 a tonne in a quiet consolidation after two days of dramatic falls.
Barge premiums were notionally Jan IPE +$23/24 fob ARA. Cargoes were Jan IPE +$25 fob NWE.
